name: media-studio
description: Creative studio for all video and audio. Infer the form from the ask, including live-product screencasts. Azure AI Services for voice, transcription and images. Product-demo-studio is the internal engine, not a second plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Video, audio, and animation from a concept, including live-product screencasts.
interface.longDescription: Single public video/audio studio. Writes a screenplay, directs the picture, casts narration and character voices through Azure AI Services (Deepgram and ElevenLabs as governed fallbacks), captures live product with Playwright when needed, and composes with Remotion, Recast, or FFmpeg. Live-product screencasts invoke the internal screencast engine; everything else stays here.
defaultPrompt: Turn this outline into a briefing video with a cast narrator.
Produce a short training clip from these bullets.
Capture this product workflow as a screencast, then narrate it.
